messages:
Sam: Heads-up, we have a small but visible repro where a streaming request + toolcall that gets truncated on reconnect ends up generating two provisional credits and later only one confirm. Customer sees double charge. Repro on staging with session id `sess-6a4` :eyes:
Nina: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro? is it streaming reconnect or a separate retry path?
Sam: Streaming reconnect. Steps:
```
1) open streaming websocket with X-Session: sess-6a4
2) send prompt that triggers toolcall mid-stream
3) simulate network hiccup (tcp RST) causing client to reconnect
4) on reconnect server issues resume, but toolcall runner also retries the toolcall because TTL expired -> two provisional ledger entries
```
Sam: logs: `router: received resume for sess-6a4, last_ack=237` then `tool-runner: ttl-expired, enqueue retry for toolcall-id=tc-77` then `ledger: provisional +0.34 tokens (sess-6a4, tc-77)` and later `ledger: confirm +0.34 tokens (sess-6a4, tc-77)` but sometimes confirm only once while provisional happened twice.
Raj: is the duplicate provisional coming from two different paths? e.g. prefetch sidecar + main router?
Sam: yes looks like sidecar prefetch produces a provisional when it first sees the toolcall, router also produces provisional when it replays unacked chunks after resume.
Nina: so double provisional but single confirm -> user billed twice until reconciliation? what does the console show?
Kevin: Console shows two provisional rows for the same session/toolcall id with different trace ids, then a single confirmed row. Current billing UI treats provisional as real charge, so customers see spike.
Nina: Can we hide provisional from the billing-facing dashboard and only show confirmed? ops/finance already complained when customers called.
Raj: Hiding provisional in ui solves customer panic but hides operational signal for us. We need telemetry to explain why provisional count > confirmed.
Sam: Proposal: add `provisional_origin` tag (values: "prefetch", "router_replay", "retry_shim") to ledger entries and expose aggregate counts in console under a new "provisional breakdown" column. That way we can show customers only confirmed cost but give us the drilldown.
Kevin: Also need to dedupe provisional creation at ingestion: if ledger sees an in-flight provisional with same (session, toolcall_id, prefix_hash) within 2s, drop duplicates. Cheap guard.
Nina: careful: race with eventual confirm. If we drop the real one we might undercount. We need idempotency key from tool-runner. Do we have that?
Sam: tool-runner can generate `toolcall_idempotency_key` (sha1 of toolcall payload + model + session) and include in provisional metadata. Router and prefetch should forward it. If ledger dedupe keys match, only one provisional recorded.
Raj: This requires changes across three services -> rollout plan?
Kevin: Canary on 10% of traffic: ledger will accept `idempotency_key` and dedupe only when header present. Router/prefetch can start sending header behind a feature flag.
ops-bot: deploy started: ledger-v2 (canary 10%) -> 6170000120
Sam: We should also update metrics: `tokens.provisional.count` tagged by provisional_origin and `tokens.confirmed.count` tagged by toolcall_id to allow sum checks. Add an alert when provisional/confirmed ratio > 1.5 for 5m across a route.
Nina: Agree. Also UX ask: in rollout console, show feature-flag status for router/prefetch so SRE can correlate spikes to canary. Right now it's a blind rollout and that caused confusion last time.
Raj: One open debate: do we make ledger dedupe window fixed 2s or adaptive to route latency? fixed window simpler. If we rely on idempotency_key matching, window can be small (200ms). Otherwise duplicates from long network jitter may still slip through.
Kevin: default to idempotency_key dedupe if present, otherwise fallback to best-effort time+prefix_hash dedupe with 2s window. Document clearly.
Sam: Another edge: truncation. If toolcall is truncated (client closed mid-toolcall), prefetch may have generated provisional for full toolcall while actual confirm comes for truncated shorter token count. Need to ensure confirm replaces provisional amount rather than just appending.
Nina: So ledger confirm should be an upsert: match by idempotency_key -> set confirmed_amount and mark provisional as reconciled. Not keep both as additive.
Raj: That changes accounting model (provisional->confirm becomes replace instead of add). Need finance review.
Kevin: I'll loop in Finance after prototyping. Meanwhile add logging `ledger: reconcile provisional id=<idempotency_key> provisional_tokens=0.34 confirm_tokens=0.18` so we have attestation.
Sam: Quick patch PR incoming for router & prefetch to emit `X-Idempotency-Key` on toolcall metadata, feature-flagged. I'll post link.
Sam: PR: https://git.company/redwood/router/pull/812 (WIP)
Nina: Thanks. Can we also add a small console toggle to hide provisional spikes on the default billing view? UX: collapse provisional under a "temporary charges" fold.
Kevin: Work with UX on phrasing. For now flagging in the incident page is fine.
ops-bot: deploy success: router-canary -> 6170000240
Raj: Sounds good. Action items: Sam - PRs for idempotency header; Kevin - ledger dedupe implementation + metrics + canary; Nina - console provisional breakdown + hide-by-default pattern; Raj - coordinate Finance review for upsert accounting semantics.
Sam: I'll create tracking ticket and link to this thread. Thanks everyone.
Kevin: thx. will post canary metrics in #eng-sre after 10m. :thumbsup:
